documents.content: Dx: rheumatoid arthritis M06.9, seropositive, rheumatologist. Prior DMARDs: hydroxychloroquine 6 mo, inadequate. Methotrexate: not trialed (see notes).

09/2026: ALT 58 U/L (ULN 40, ~1.4x), AST normal. Hx of NAFLD on US 2024. Moderate alcohol use (reports 5-7 drinks/wk). Discussed MTX hepatotoxicity risk; patient prefers to avoid MTX. Plan: proceed to TNF inhibitor.
